title: wg: content-09 §5.2/§5.3 example hex and prose mismatch
description: Erratum. Hex dumps (L1132, L1244) carry the -07 inReplyTo 01b00844..., but the EDN uses 017ce548... (L1015, L1215). L1169-1170 describes the reaction as U+2665 (0xe299a5) but EDN (L1226) and bytes (L1269 e29da4) are U+2764. mimid follows the repo .cbor files (decisions mimid-1wgh.2.17, .2.18). Fix: regenerate dumps, correct prose.
notes:
Root cause: repo example files disagree: examples/implied-original.pretty has 01b00844... while implied-original.edn has 017ce548...; examples/reaction.edn:21 labels the heart U+2665 though it is U+2764. Fix files and inline hex together.
Also (from .2.5): implied-original.cbor/.pretty carry the -07 MessageId 01b00844... while .edn and §5.1 say 017ce548... (the -09 algorithm's output). Upstream generate-examples.py uses len(str) (characters) for URI lengths where §3.3 says octets; same result for the ASCII example URIs.
